depiction.primary_object: rounded diamond outline framing a centered exclamation mark
depiction.composition: centered symbol inside rotated square border

ambiguity: Nearly interchangeable with triangle or circle exclamation-mark alert icons, and resembles a GHS chemical hazard diamond.

modifier_semantics.meaning: warning, hazard, alert, or attention required

task_intents: put up caution or hazard sign

example_tasks.task: Look up what the blinking yellow error code on the boiler means
Report the fallen branch blocking the blind curve on Oak Lane
Order two wet-floor caution signs for the back kitchen entrance
Check FDA allergy warnings before packing snacks for the school trip
Update chemical hazard labels on the garage shelf containers
Document top five deployment risks before Friday's database migration
Check avalanche warning bulletin for the north ridge before Saturday
Send photos to the landlord before someone trips on the loose step
Go through the open items with the lead engineer before launch

example_tasks_es: Revisar las alertas de seguridad del servidor de correo
Comprobar si el lote de leche infantil está en la lista de retiradas
Señalizar el escalón suelto de la entrada para que nadie tropiece
example_tasks_ru: Проверить код ошибки на дисплее стиральной машины
Настроить оповещения о сбоях в мониторинге сервера
Составить список рисков перед запуском нового склада

context_tasks.task: Buy reflective tape for the driveway posts
Replace the frayed extension cord behind the workbench
Draft postmortem document for Tuesday's outage
Pack bear spray for the Glacier backcountry loop

near_misses.task: Pay overdue electricity bill urgently today
Buy Risk board game for family night
Check tire pressure before driving to the mountains
Order new hard hats and safety goggles
Read information kiosk map at the trailhead

reasoning: A diamond warning sign with an exclamation mark clearly communicates hazards, warnings, risks, and system alerts. It fits tasks centered on safety hazards, recalls, error codes, or risk logs, though it is easily confused with triangular or circular alert icons and should not be used merely to mark an ordinary task as urgent.
